companion.disposition: installed as an exact runtime dependency; the TUI adapter uses its task/menu lifecycle helpers

adaptation: AILI retains bounded search and immutable snapshot selection in src/runtime/file-context.ts, restores the upstream File Context Explorer under extensions/file-context/, and registers the adapter through the sole top-level Pi extension entry. The companion pi-tui-kit dependency is pinned exactly to 0.53.0.
